application.name: CreaProDroid
application.summary: Un Asistente de IA basado en Google Gemini para Android Antiguo 4.2-8.1 / An AI Assistant based on Google Gemini for Old Android 4.1-9
application.desc:
CreaProDroid is an artificial intelligence assistant designed specifically for older Android devices (versions 4.1 to 9). Powered by Google Gemini and Pollinations.ai technology, this assistant is optimized to offer a smooth and helpful experience on resource-constrained devices. If this version is not compatible, you can try [CreaProPhone J2ME](https://github.com/Creadores-Program/CreaProPhone) with J2ME Loader, which extends compatibility back to Android 2.3.
## **Features** - **AI Assistant**: Answers questions, performs tasks, and provides personalized assistance. - **Legacy Android Compatibility**: Designed to run on devices running Android 4.1 through 9. - **Voice Recognition**: Allows interaction using voice commands. - **Image Generation**: Generates images based on user descriptions powered by Pollinations.ai. - **App Launcher**: Can open installed applications on your device. - **File Support**: Processes text files provided by the user. - **User-Friendly Interface**: Intuitive and easy-to-use design.
## **Requirements** - **Android Version**: 4.1 (Jelly Bean) to 9 (Pie). - **Required Permissions**: - Internet access. - Read and write to external storage. - Microphone usage for voice recognition.
## **Usage** 1. **Initial Setup**: - Enter your Google Gemini API Key obtained from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). - Enter your name to personalize the experience. 2. **Interaction**: - Type or speak your questions or commands. - Use the microphone button for voice commands. - Attach files for processing. 3. **Additional Features**: - Generate images based on prompt descriptions. - Open installed applications on your device. - Clear chat history whenever you want. - AI Plugins support to add extended features like sending messages, making calls, and more. - Gemini Model selector.
## **Contributing** If you would like to contribute to the development of CreaProDroid: 1. Fork the repository github. 2. Create a new branch for your changes. 3. Submit a pull request with a detailed description of your changes.
## Credits - GitHub Copilot - Microsoft Copilot - Gemini - MarkdownToHtml - Google Fonts - OkHttp - okio - AndroidX Browser Custom Tabs - Pollinations.ai - Conscrypt

application.name: CreaTV
application.summary: Unofficial Stream Platforms client for android 4.1-10/Cliente no oficial de Plataformas de Streams para android 4.1-10
application.desc:
**CreaTV** is an unofficial streaming platform client specifically designed for **Android 2.3 to Android 10** devices. It allows lightweight and optimized access to live streaming content.
---
## 🚀 Features & Compatibility
CreaTV supports the most popular streaming platforms:
- 🟣 **Twitch** - 🟢 **Kick** - 🖤 **TikTok Live** - 🔴 **YouTube Live** *(Implemented via iframe API to bypass anti-bot restrictions)*
---
## ⚙️ System Requirements
- **Operating System:** Android 2.3 (Gingerbread) up to Android 10 (Quince Tart). - **External Video Player:** An external video player installed on the device is **required** to play streams.
---
## 🧪 Testing & Player Recommendations
- ❌ **Google Photos:** Likely to fail or experience incompatibility issues when attempting to stream on older Android versions. - ✅ **VLC Player (Recommended for Android 4.0+):** It is strongly recommended to use **VLC Player**, as it offers greater stability, compatibility with network formats and advanced features such as Picture-in-Picture (PiP). > [!WARNING] > Presents unexpected closures (crashes) on **Android 2.3 to 3.2** - ✅ **MX Player (Recommended for Android 2.3–3.2):** It works correctly and without failures in legacy versions where VLC generates problems.
---
## 💬 Chat Support
Currently, live chat is **only supported for Twitch**.
### How to use the chat feature? 1. Enable the chat checkbox inside the **CreaTV** app. 2. When starting a stream, launch the external video player (e.g., VLC Player) and tap the **Minimize / Picture-in-Picture (PiP)** option. 3. The video will float in a small window while the live chat renders in the background.
---
## ⚠️ Known Issues & Technical Notes
### 1. Backend Delays / Cold Starts (Render.com) Occasionally, launching a non-YouTube stream or loading the YouTube Player may trigger **uncontextualized errors** or a **timeout**. - **Cause:** To keep the app completely free, the backend server is hosted on **Render.com** (free tier). If the instance goes idle, it takes a few seconds to spin back up. - **Solution:** If a stream fails on the first attempt, **simply try again after 3 seconds**.
### 2. Performance on Older Android Versions (Android 2.3 - 4.4) - Devices running Android 2.3 to 4.4 (Gingerbread / KitKat) may experience **lag or bugs** on YouTube Live streams. This is caused by the unoptimized iframe API performance on legacy system WebViews.
---
## 🎨 Credits
- **Logo Design:** zManuReal_
---
## 📄 Disclaimer
* **Disclaimer:** CreaTV is an unofficial client and is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Twitch, Kick, TikTok, YouTube, or Google.

application.name: F-Droid Classic
application.summary: A modern F-Droid Classic fork with TLS 1.2/1.3 support for legacy Android 2.3+.
application.desc:
# F-Droid Classic (Crea Fork)
F-Droid Classic (Crea Fork) is an alternative F-Droid client developed and maintained by Creadores-Program. This version is based on the classic pre-1.0 official client UI, built to deliver a lightweight, clear, and straightforward experience for users who prefer functionality over modern tile-based interfaces.
---
## 🌟 Key Features
* **TLS 1.2 & 1.3 Support:** Includes backported modern security protocols, enabling secure connections to F-Droid repositories on legacy devices running Android 2.3 and up. * **Lightweight Classic Interface:** Features an intuitive layout where essential package info, permissions, and version histories are immediately accessible without hidden menus. * **Zero Ads & Telemetry:** 100% focused on user privacy and true FOSS principles, with no proprietary tracking or analytics libraries. * **Optimized Performance:** Minimal memory and processor overhead, making it ideal for low-spec hardware, legacy devices, and custom ROMs. * **Advanced Options:** Full support for index-v1 format, Privileged Extension support for background installs, inline changelogs, and screenshot previews.
---
## 💬 Community & Support
To report bugs, suggest features, or follow the latest updates:
* **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/Creadores-Program/F-droid-Classic-Crea * **Discord Community:** https://discord.com/invite/mrmHcwxXff

application.name: 旧版互传
application.summary: A lightweight LocalSend-compatible Android app for Android 2.3-6
application.desc:
An independently developed, native Android Java application for local area network (LAN) file transfers. Its goal is to provide compatibility with the device discovery and Upload API of LocalSend Protocol v2.2 on legacy devices (Android 2.3 through Android 6.0 / API 9 to API 23). The project does not reference, import, or build from any LocalSend source directories.
> **⚠️ NOTE:** > The **Legacy20** build targeting Android 2.0 - 2.2 (API 5–8) is currently an **experimental** feature. Due to severe API limitations in the TLS/JSSE libraries and Dalvik runtime of early Android systems, this build requires the [Wolfius](https://github.com/gohoski/Wolfius) environment/patch to properly perform HTTPS encrypted transfers and run correctly. > > *This project is a fork of [legacysend](https://github.com/Blithe-Chiang/legacysend).*
## Features
* UDP multicast device discovery, announcements, and response handling. * HTTP/HTTPS LocalSend v2 (v2.2) registration endpoints. * Support for Chunked Transfer Encoding. * Single and multi-file selection, sending, and receiving. * Accept / Decline prompt before receiving. * File-level token, session ID, origin IP, and certificate fingerprint validation. * Streaming uploads and disk saving without loading complete files into memory. * Overall progress tracking, error notifications, and cancellation support from either side. * Automatic renaming with `(1)`, `(2)` suffixes to prevent overwrites. * Compatibility with filenames containing Chinese characters, spaces, and special symbols. * Foreground service for receiving; Activity recreation does not interrupt ongoing transfers. * User interface localized in Simplified Chinese.
## Main Project Structure
```text app/src/main/java/com/blithe/legacysend/ ├── LegacySendApp.java App-level state, background tasks, and UI events ├── ReceiveService.java Foreground keep-alive receiving service ├── discovery/ UDP multicast discovery ├── model/ Data models for devices and files ├── protocol/ LocalSend JSON protocol formats (v2.2) ├── security/ Self-signed identity, BKS KeyStore, mTLS, certificate pinning, SimpleX509Generator ├── server/ HTTP/HTTPS endpoints (register, prepare, upload, cancel) ├── storage/ Storage handling with SAF, legacy file system, and renaming logic ├── transfer/ HTTPS/HTTP sending client, progress control, and cancellation ├── ui/ Native Android Views user interface └── util/ Stream copying and transfer speed utilities
```
The source code is 100% Java—no dependencies on Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Flutter, Dart, or React Native. Uses Groovy DSL for Gradle.
## Compatibility & Adaptations for Android 2.3–6.0 (API 9–23)
